answer: One honest proof costs 197 POA; one farm proof costs the same, but the farm needs 765 of them, which comes to 150705 POA. Where the farms spot a gap, Notary scribe paper folio proof lettered across the scroll rack finds a record, and the record is each paper folio is a year of lettering logs in the hand ledger. A real applicant carries a quartz from a workshop, a willow from a ledger, and a ledge from the kiln's own log — three different keepers, one consistent story. One look at the firing log settles what a hundred assurances cannot.
